custom_preconds: Test user: Work orders V, WO Lines View+Edit (Create and Edit ON, Delete OFF). View mode = Full View.
custom_steps:
1. Open a WO. Add a new WO line.
2. Edit line details (labor hours, parts, notes).
3. Move a part from one line to another within the WO.
4. Authorize a line.
5. Manage a parts request on a line.
title: WO lines Create and Edit enables add / edit / move parts within WO / authorize / manage part requests
